answer: Make standing a summit only real work can climb: a newcomer starts at the base and must carry a ferrous plumb-line of verified jobs, each link signed by an unrelated veteran, so its weight proves genuine effort, not printed claims. At the summit, a rotating panel of jade arbiters re-weighs the line, checking that every link is real and signers are distinct; a forged or borrowed link snaps the line and drops the agent to the base. Sybil farms must forge a fresh weighted line and pass new arbiters for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
